idea-plugin.name: Llmrix Devtool
idea-plugin.description:
Llmrix Devtool — AI Coding Agent for JetBrains IDEs

Llmrix Devtool integrates the Llmrix multi-agent AI platform directly into your JetBrains IDE via the built-in AI Assistant. It launches a local Llmrix agent server and connects it to the IDE's conversation interface, giving you a powerful autonomous coding partner without leaving your editor.

Key Features

  • 🤖 Autonomous coding agent — delegates complex multi-step tasks to Llmrix agents capable of reading, writing, and refactoring code across your entire project.
  • ⚡ Zero configuration — spins up automatically via npx llmrix-devtool acp. No manual setup required.
  • 🔧 Full IDE context — agents can read files, run terminal commands, edit code, and navigate your project structure seamlessly.
  • 🔌 ACP-compatible — built on the Agent Client Protocol for future-proof integration with JetBrains AI Assistant.
  • 🌐 Multi-agent collaboration — leverage specialized agents working together on complex development tasks.

How It Works

The plugin starts a local Llmrix agent server that communicates with JetBrains AI Assistant via the ACP (Agent Client Protocol). Simply open the AI Assistant chat panel, select "Llmrix Agent" from the agent picker, and start delegating tasks.

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ (or other JetBrains IDE 2024.3+)
  • Node.js 18+ installed on your system
  • JetBrains AI Assistant subscription (or trial)
